data.body: AMENDMENT (KEEP version-bump decision, 2026-06-03): DD3a's version-file coverage exemption (rc_diff_is_exempt_only, the version.file_path arm) is REMOVED. Under KEEP (resilience-hardening-plan SS9.5/SS9.6, owned by story 3ebb-fa93-f980-40de DD2) the version bump rides PR1's review-sub-pr (plugin.json allowlisted -> skip-to-success) and is COVERED per-SHA like any commit -- no separate coverage exemption needed. Retain ONLY the ticket-store exemption (rc_diff_is_tickets_only). Drop the E-version test case (no orphan version SHA exists under KEEP -- the bump always rides PR1). DD7 reduces to keeping plugin.json in the review-gate ALLOWLIST (review-sub-pr skip); the coverage-invariant version exemption is gone. This story now depends_on 3ebb (DD1 tristate + DD2 KEEP).
